messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden RPM surge on model-family "gryphon-13b" (+360% over 10m). Auto-paged eng-oncall.

sam_oncall: ack. taking it. pulling perf dashboards and tenant breakdown.

riley_sre: seeing request queue growth on gryphon workers and p99 latency climbing. top contributor is tenant-8792 — ~48% of family RPM.

maya_support: customers complaining about 429s and timeouts. I have a list of affected customers from support queue.

sam_oncall: we need a surgical response — prefer per-tenant carveout + modest family throttle to buy time. Proposal: family RPM -> 90, TPM -> 2500; tenant-8792 soft-cap RPM 20.

riley_sre: agree. soft-cap first (less customer surprise). apply tenant carveout via /admin/tenant-quotas then family limit if needed.

sam_oncall: apply tenant soft cap now. paste API call when executed.

riley_sre: POST /admin/tenant-quotas
{
  "tenant_id": "tenant-8792",
  "model_family": "gryphon",
  "quota": { "rpm": 20 },
  "type": "soft_cap",
  "reason": "emergency per-tenant carveout to protect family stability"
}

ops-bot: tenant-quotas: queued -> applied on edge nodes (canary 50% first).

ops-bot: rollout 1/2 applied to canary nodes, no errors.

sam_oncall: monitoring metrics. 5m after carveout: family RPM down ~30%, p99 improved slightly but still elevated.

maya_support: fewer new 429 tickets, but a couple of enterprise customers still seeing errors — updating them: "temporary limits in place while we stabilize"

riley_sre: prepping family throttle command as fallback. will not disable funcall yet — only if token churn persists.

tori_sre: FYI, I can spin an emergency per-tenant hard block if tenant ignores backoff. Keep me on standby.

sam_oncall: proceeding to apply conservative family throttle: PATCH /admin/quotas
{
  "model_family": "gryphon",
  "quota": { "rpm": 90, "tpm": 2500 },
  "note": "temporary family throttle after tenant spike"
}

ops-bot: quota change accepted. rollout: 25% -> 100% over 3 batches.

ops-bot: 2/3 batches complete. no rejection spikes.

sam_oncall: metrics: p50/p90 normalized, p99 dropping. tenant-8792 now at ~18 RPM. No surge retries visible yet.

kevin_product: need to coordinate comms for impacted customers. I'll draft a note in INC-2026-999.

maya_support: comms draft posted. advising customers on temporary throttling and expected timeline for next update.

tori_sre: handoff in 30m. I'll watch for retry storms and tenant backoff behavior. If we see tenant retry cascade, we may flip a hard block and re-open with rate-limited token bucket.

sam_oncall: good. creating incident record INC-2026-999 and logging actions + tenant list for postmortem.

riley_sre: postmortem notes: consider auto-triggered tenant soft-caps when a single tenant >40% of family RPM and automated detect+carveout playbook.

sam_oncall: closing thread for now — status: stabilizing. handoff to tori at 1789999400. :white_check_mark:
